source_text: Omnis qui pie vult vivere persecutionem patitur. Sta in castris armatus. Synagoga Domini in castra divisa — vigila.
pass_a_gloss: Every who piously wills to-live persecution suffers. Stand in camps armed. Synagogue of-Lord into camps divided — watch.
pass_b_english: [[All who want to live piously in Christ suffer persecution >> Bible:2 Timothy 3:12]]. Stand armed in camp. The Lord’s congregation is arranged in camps — keep watch.
